items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: Well, I don't know them, but some of them, Mumford, I know him,

ctx.x: that's when he really began to get famous then. After 1900, after 1900 come in. Do you remember who else was in his band then? Any of the other men?
Well, I don't know them, but some of them, Mumford, I know him,

but none of them, all of them dead. I can tell you why you can go in the neighborhood and find out. Manny used to play with them. The bass fiddle player, and, what you call them? The guitar player. I don't know whether they're living or not, but you go Cherokee and Ann. Cherokee and Ann. We'll go out there. You been out there? I think I know the neighborhood. What? You know, that's the thing. I know.
